info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Trade Banking Cheque Lock Box-spec
info.description: The Trade Banking Cheque Lock Box Management API facilitates the creation of cheque lock boxes, a vital service for managing trade banking operations. This endpoint allows businesses to securely generate and store cheque lock boxes, enhancing cash flow management and transaction accountability. Ideally suited for financial institutions and trade businesses, this API streamlines the process of setting up cheque handling systems. By utilizing this API, users can effectively improve operational efficiency and ensure the integrity of financial transactions.

post.summary: Create a new Cheque Lock Box.
post.description: This operation allows you to create a new Cheque Lock Box in the Trade Banking system, which can be used to securely manage customer cheques.
